package.description: Desktop power draw widget with Screen Time-style history graphs

en-US.description: Desktop power draw widget with Screen Time-style history graphs
en-US.longDescription: WattAWidget pins a small always-on-desktop widget that shows your PC's live power draw - true battery telemetry on battery, a self-calibrating CPU+GPU sensor estimate on AC - with a 30-minute sparkline, 24-hour and 7-day history charts, kWh and electricity-cost estimates, and a battery health readout.
en-US.name: WattAWidget
